name: Compare semantic versions
text: Compare major, then minor, then patch components as integers. Return the exact newer version label from the evidence.

name: Compare ISO dates
text: For YYYY-MM-DD dates, compare year, then month, then day. Return the exact later date from the evidence.

name: Choose lower latency
text: Compare latency values in the same unit and choose the named option with the smaller value.

name: Answer from evidence
text: Identify the requested attribute, use only explicit evidence, and abstain when the attribute is missing or conflicting.
